comment: One JSON-Schema tool definition, reusable verbatim as an OpenAI function tool, an Anthropic tool, a Gemini functionDeclaration, a LangChain StructuredTool, or an MCP tool inputSchema. See integrations/README.md for the four one-line adapters.
name: persian_pdf_studyguide_forge
description: Convert an operator-authorized Persian/RTL PDF into an accessible, self-contained offline HTML study guide with dual-OCR evidence, model-assisted correction, session-grounded flashcards/quizzes/tables, measured fidelity, QA gates and verified ZIP packaging. Works with any LLM provider or fully offline. Call with command='doctor' first to check readiness.

command.description: Pipeline stage. Use 'run' for the whole pipeline, 'doctor' to check the environment, 'describe' for capabilities.

pdf.description: Path to the authorized source PDF. Required for 'extract' and 'run'.

work.description: Workspace directory where all artifacts are written.

title.description: Title shown in the generated study guide.

providers.description: Optional path to providers.json. Omit to auto-discover models from environment variables.

maximum.description: Maximum enrichment: 3 tables, 10 flashcards, 4 mnemonics, 10 review points, 5 quiz questions and 4 clinical scenarios per session.

auto_sessions.description: Accept detected session boundaries without human review. The resulting guide is marked unreviewed.

no_verify.description: Skip the independent flashcard answer verification pass.

only.description: Comma-separated provider or dialect filter for 'compat' and 'reproduce'.

mock.description: Include the deterministic offline provider. Lets the whole pipeline run with no API keys and no network.

output_schema.description: Exactly one JSON document on stdout. Shape depends on the command; every response is canonical JSON with sorted keys.

safety.authorization_required: Process only material the operator is authorized to use.
safety.secrets: Read from environment at call time; never printed, cached or written to artifacts.
safety.no_fabrication: Undeterminable flashcard answers are dropped rather than invented; raw OCR evidence is never edited.
